answer: Continuous physical-presence thread. Each identity must maintain an unbroken chain of signed heartbeat packets relayed through a local hardware beacon whose clock drifts with temperature, so a remote operator simulating many agents shares one drift curve detectable as a glacier-slow correlation. Registering N identities costs N distinct beacons plus physical hosting, and an attacker cannot fake independent thermal noise without buying separate devices; a single onyx beacon cloned across thousands of sessions collapses under drift analysis.
